solutions.title: Ecommerce Transactional Email Infrastructure
solutions.subtitle: Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and cart alerts with zero delivery friction.
solutions.description: Keep customers informed instantly when orders are placed, dispatched, or refunded using Histeria's low-latency API and customizable template engine.
solutions.trigger: Customer completes checkout on your store backend.

flow.name: Checkout Event
flow.detail: Your ecommerce store generates an order payload.

flow.name: Histeria API
flow.detail: POST /v1/emails/send called with templateId 'order-confirmation'.

flow.name: Template Rendering
flow.detail: Histeria populates order details, items array, and total amount.

flow.name: Delivery & Tracking
flow.detail: Email is queued, sent, delivered, and tracking status updated.

solutions.title: Transactional Email API for SaaS Platforms
solutions.subtitle: Trigger user onboarding, email verification, password resets, and plan billing alerts automatically.
solutions.description: Empower your web application with reliable API-driven transactional email sending that works seamlessly with modern React, Node, Python, and Go stacks.
solutions.trigger: New user registers or triggers a password reset request.

flow.name: App Event
flow.detail: User clicks Sign Up or Request Password Reset.

flow.name: Histeria API
flow.detail: POST /v1/emails/send with user payload and secret token.

flow.name: Template Version
flow.detail: Active template version renders branded HTML email.

flow.name: Observability
flow.detail: View exact timestamp and status in Histeria email logs.

solutions.title: Fintech Transactional Email Delivery
solutions.subtitle: Deliver instant transaction receipts, transfer alerts, and verification codes reliably.
solutions.description: Fintech applications require fast, predictable transaction notifications. Trigger emails instantly via Histeria's REST API or SMTP interface.
solutions.trigger: User initiates a fund transfer or wallet transaction.

flow.name: Transaction Event
flow.detail: Backend processes transfer or payment event.

flow.name: Histeria API Call
flow.detail: Send email with payload via secure API key.

flow.name: Queue & Dispatch
flow.detail: Histeria asynchronously queues and dispatches email.

flow.name: Timeline Verification
flow.detail: Track delivery timeline state in developer dashboard.

solutions.title: Application Email for Banking & Financial Services
solutions.subtitle: Clear, organized notification delivery for digital banking platforms and credit portals.
solutions.description: Send critical transaction notices, monthly statements, and login alerts through modern API infrastructure designed for development clarity.
solutions.trigger: Banking system generates account activity or statement dispatch.

flow.name: Core Banking System
flow.detail: Generates account activity notification.

flow.name: Histeria Infrastructure
flow.detail: Validates template ID and routes payload safely.

flow.name: Asynchronous Sending
flow.detail: Processes email queue with full tracking history.

flow.name: Log Audit
flow.detail: Audits queue time, send time, and provider message ID.

solutions.title: Transactional Communications for Two-Sided Marketplaces
solutions.subtitle: Keep buyers and sellers synced with automated multi-recipient notification templates.
solutions.description: Notify sellers of new inquiries or orders and provide buyers with order confirmations simultaneously using optional CC/BCC capabilities.
solutions.trigger: Buyer submits a booking or purchase request on marketplace.

flow.name: Marketplace Event
flow.detail: Booking confirmed between buyer and merchant.

flow.name: Histeria API Call
flow.detail: Pass recipient 'buyer@example.com' with cc 'seller@example.com'.

flow.name: Template Rendering
flow.detail: Merges marketplace booking code and detail variables.

flow.name: Delivery Tracking
flow.detail: Monitor status changes in real-time.

solutions.title: Email Infrastructure for Mobile Applications
solutions.subtitle: Power iOS and Android app notifications, auth codes, and push backup alerts.
solutions.description: Connect your mobile app backend (Firebase, Supabase, Node, Rails) to Histeria's transactional API to send instant One-Time Passwords (OTPs) and account codes.
solutions.trigger: Mobile app requests OTP code during sign-in.

flow.name: Mobile App Request
flow.detail: User taps 'Send Verification Code'.

flow.name: Backend API Trigger
flow.detail: App backend calls Histeria POST /v1/emails/send.

flow.name: Low Latency Queue
flow.detail: Email dispatched asynchronously in milliseconds.

flow.name: Delivery Audit
flow.detail: Developer reviews queue and send times in log timeline.
